member.name: T:Constellation.Core.Telemetry.ConstellationTelemetry
member.summary: The single and through which every Constellation component emits metrics and spans. Constellation takes no dependency on any exporter: a host subscribes to and (for example with Radiant or the OpenTelemetry SDK). When nothing is subscribed every recording is a near-free no-op and every span start returns null. All recording is best-effort: a failing listener never propagates an exception into request handling. Thread safety: all members are thread safe.

member.name: T:Constellation.Core.Telemetry.TelemetryConstants
member.summary: Stable telemetry names emitted by Constellation: the meter and activity source names, every metric instrument name, every span name, and every metric label and span attribute key. These strings are a public contract consumed by collectors and Grafana dashboards; treat a rename as a breaking change. See TELEMETRY.md for the full catalog. Thread safety: all members are constants and are safe to read from any thread.
